title: Welcome to Northwind Labs, Alex Tan

meta: Role: Backend Engineer · Level: junior · Manager: Priya Menon · Buddy: Daniel Wong
scenes.say: Welcome to Northwind Labs, Alex Tan. Let's read your first piece of real code.

scenes.title: What you own
say: That means you are the last engineer before the database. If a query is slow or wrong, it is yours to fix.
Migrations are version-controlled. Run them in order and never edit a committed migration in place.
One working day keeps the team unblocked. If you need more time, say so early — a comment beats a silent delay.

scenes.title: Where it all begins
scenes.point: Requests enter through main() at the top of the file
scenes.say: Every request begins at the top of the file, where main is defined. Imports and the database path live here.

scenes.title: Where it starts at runtime
scenes.point: One request flows from main() to get_user() and back
scenes.say: Everything starts in main, on line eleven. One request flows from main to get user, and back.

scenes.title: The whole file, two views
scenes.point: Two places to know: the top of the file and the entry point
scenes.say: Keep two places in mind: the entry point, and the top of the file where the imports live.
